subject: Difference in nonlinear_quantlim results Windows vs Linux

messages.author: ba334c27be872358
messages.subject: Difference in nonlinear_quantlim results Windows vs Linux
parts:
Dear MSstats team,

I am using the function nonlinear_quantlim from the MSstats package in a script that I deploy both in a Windows and Linux environement. However, I noticed that I get different results depending on the OS. I am not sure if this difference is related to package dependencies (i.e. some packages that are essential to this function could have different versions on my Windows R session vs my Linux R session) or if it is expected to have different results depending on the OS, for example due a difference in the seed between the OS. 

Could you help me understand where this difference can come from? Any idea on what are the package dependencies for this function that could explain such a difference in the result? 

Thanks a lot for your help.

Best regards,
Tuvana
